entries.title: Smarter ULTRA game building, sturdier games, Test and Undo in Preview
items: ULTRA now recognises a game request and plans it as a game. The brief covers touch and keyboard controls, a game loop that runs the same speed on any screen, title, pause, level, win and game-over screens, Play again, a score bar and a saved high score.

After building a game, ULTRA tests it as a game: it checks the loop, touch controls, keyboard, game over, restart, pause and phone layout. It no longer asks a game to grow app tabs. Anything missing goes into its fix loop, which stops after 2 rounds.
When you change a game, ULTRA is told to keep its controls, pause and Play again working. If a change fails its check, your app stays as it was.

Game Creation Engine fixes: games pause when you switch apps (and held keys are released), tapping the screen resumes, R restarts, and a stray tap right at game over no longer restarts the game straight away.
Preview → 🧪 Test runs the same hidden check ULTRA uses and lists what passed. If something is wrong, Ask ULTRA to fix sends exactly what was found.
Preview → ↩️ Undo goes back to the previous version in one tap, saved as a new version, so nothing is lost.

entries.title: Better Preview and Customise for your projects
items: Preview has Phone, Tablet and Full sizes, and it remembers the one you last used. There's also a Reload button.
If your app hits a real error while it runs, Preview shows the message and gives you an “Ask ULTRA to fix” button, which sends ULTRA those exact errors.
🛠 Customise for template apps, websites and full-stack projects: change the name, look, layout, tone and features, then Apply. You get a new version and keep what you'd added.
🛠 Customise for games made with the Game Creation Engine: change difficulty, levels, lives (up to 9), scoring, look, the player, enemy and collectable emoji, and the toggles. Your high score is kept.
Preview now has a one-tap ZIP download, and Install is now called “Open / Install” (it opens your app on its own page).
Clearer notes: Preview data is saved on this device only, the sign-in is a demo, and the full-stack Node server is a starting point, not a secure production backend.

entries.title: Real apps, websites, full-stack builds and a bigger Game Creation Engine
items: Builder → “Start from a template”: choose App, Website or Full-stack, pick from 19 templates, then set the look, layout, tone and features (dark mode, sign-in, search, charts, forms, export, FAQ, reviews, pricing, blog).
⚡ Create now builds a real multi-page project instantly and for free; it opens in Preview and is saved in My apps. ✨ Build with ULTRA sends the same choices to the AI.
Full-stack templates (tasks, shop, bookings, CMS, helpdesk) include a REST API. Preview uses a built-in mock; Export the ZIP and run npm start to get the real Node server and a db.json.

Game Studio has a new Game Creation Engine with 11 playable genres: shooter with boss fights, brick breaker, sky jumper, flappy, runner, snake, asteroids, pong vs AI, catcher, maze chase and tap reflex.

Game options: difficulty, levels (or endless), lives, scoring, look, your own player and enemy emoji, power-ups, boss levels, sound and an on-screen touch pad. ▶ Play now gives you the game straight away.
8 more AI game templates (tower defence, RPG, survival, rhythm, memory, mini golf, idle clicker, word game), plus more build questions for websites, apps and arcade games.

entries.title: 59 plugins, Grok, PDF books, new art
items: Plugins library: 52 new working tools in 6 groups (Everyday, Info & web, Create, Developer, Voice & media, Life & learning) plus the 7 organisers — search, filter, install/switch off
Weather, currency, Wikipedia, dictionary, news, GitHub, holidays, countries, ISS — free, no sign-up APIs

QR maker & scanner, palettes, logo & meme makers, emoji & icon pickers, charts, passwords, Markdown, JSON, regex, hashes, voice, recorder, image resizer, journal, flashcards, quizzes, mind maps, translator and writers
ULTRA answers instantly with installed plugins ("weather in Perth", "convert 5 km to miles", "define serendipity") and builds them into your apps

entries.title: Own it, share it, write books
items: Export any app as a ZIP with the full source (index.html, styles.css, app.js, manifest, icons, README for GitHub Pages / Netlify / Vercel) plus a standalone HTML, and optionally its data
Export everything + Export all my data — you own your code
Share an app by link (the app travels inside the link) — opens on its own page, 'Save to my Archangel'
Community: showcase, play others' apps, shared projects by link (demo mode)
Marketplace: free listings and give-aways (selling and donations coming soon)
Ownership & docs: record of authorship with a code fingerprint, licence picker, copyright notice, terms & privacy templates, publishing checklist
Books: plan chapters with ULTRA, write, cover, export EPUB and PDF
Welcome tour, searchable Settings, cloud backup via your phone's share sheet, new Archangel art

entries.title: The Builder, My apps and fresh ideas
items: New Builder page: a detailed plan first (screens, features, data, flows, design, milestones), then it builds milestone by milestone by itself
Tabs: Plan, Build log, Code (live, with line numbers), Preview and Details
Apps now look like real phone apps: splash screen, app bar, bottom tabs, cards — and are checked for empty screens
My apps: change an app with ULTRA, edit its code, rename it, new icon, versions and go back, duplicate, delete
Lots of new ideas to tap, a fresh set every visit (written by your AI when you have a key)
Settings → Updates: see your version, check for updates and what's new
